items.title: John Handy Interview, 1963-11-21
items.q: Who else was in this Tuk Johnson band? ... Mal Johnson was the bass player.

ctx.x: So, uh, that's how I come to these tones. Uh-huh. Who else was in this Tuk Johnson band? Uh-huh.
I don't know if you've seen a line. It was, uh, Tootsie Self used to get up with. Mal Johnson was the bass player. Clarence Thompson was the drummer.
